name: 4-dimethyl ionone
description: 4-Dimethyl ionone (CAS 68459-99-4 ) is a synthetic fragrance and flavoring ingredient valued for its woody, violet-like, and orris-type character. It belongs to the ionone family and delivers a distinctive floral-woody profile. Perfumers and flavorists use this compound to add depth and lift to finished formulations. In fine fragrance and personal care, it anchors floral accords in perfumes, body lotions, and hair care products. It is particularly useful where a lasting woody-violet note is required. Home care formulators incorporate it into fabric conditioners, air fresheners, and surface cleaners to impart a clean, powdery-floral scent profile. In flavor applications, it contributes a subtle woody-floral nuance to confectionery, baked goods, and beverage formulations. Low-use-level impact is commercially important for these specific food and drink categories. Its tenacity on skin and fabric also makes it a preferred choice for leave-on cosmetic applications. Fragrance longevity is a key sourcing criterion for manufacturers developing high-end personal care products. 4-Dimethyl ionone is supplied as a liquid and is available in fragrance-grade and flavor-grade specifications. These options meet the distinct purity and compliance requirements of each global end market. Buyers should confirm conformance to relevant industry standards when evaluating supplier documentation.
